set.body: Implement docs/plans/2026-10-27-graphics-api.md under VISION section 7. Direct prepared-scene lowering to wgpu is the baseline: G-0 defines GPU mappings, batching/resources, ownership and copy accounting; G-1 freezes the capability inventory and budgets; G-2 is the Stage 2 nucleus; G-3/G-4 qualify the full matrix and public-only Intaglio integration, including its separately qualified Native port. Skia is an optional alternative motivated by evidence, not a prerequisite or mandatory evaluation. Preserve native ABI, thread and pause gates and existing kernel semantics.
set.title: G-0–G-4: Qualify public graphics with direct wgpu lowering
